children: may rise to $3,690 per ounce, the peak of a wave 4.
A retracement analysis on the fall from $3,690 reveals a break above the 61.8% level of $3,590. The break increases the metal's chance to climb to $3,690.
Another retracement analysis on the fall from $4,148 marks a target of $3,705, the 38.2% level, while a projection analysis on a wave c from $3,553 points at $3,730, the 100% level.
A correction from the current level may be limited to the support at $3,595. On the daily chart, a five-wave cycle from $4,148 was over.
The metal is expected to climb into a wide range of $3,689-$3,901, formed by the peaks of the wave 4 and the wave 2.
